[[File:Wheat patch.gif|left|thumb|Wheat growing in the garden.]]
<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a form of crop which can be grown from [[Wheat seeds]] in the garden below the [[workyard]] known as the [[Kitchen Garden|kitchen garden]]. Alternatively it can be purchased from the [[Miller]]. Wheat is not an improvable crop, meaning it does not have a variety of quality levels and cannot be improved with fertilizer.  It can only be made to grow faster using boost fertilizers.  See the page on [[farming]] for more information on how crops are grown and improved.
